messages:
sam: reopening follow-up from yesterday's outage (CloudNet routing flap + AuthCo token saturation). Wanted a compact tracker for owners, blockers, and short mitigations.
nina: thanks. quick wins I can do: add client-side circuit breaker for model fetches and lower retry count to 2. I'll target 2026-04-01.
rahul: I'll take vendor escalation and contract-level SLAs (AuthCo rate limits). ETA 2026-04-10. filed support ticket AC-932.
devon: ops will add a pinned model cache with TTL and signature verification as emergency fallback. estimate 2026-03-29.
incident-bot: 48h check-in reminder scheduled 2026-03-28 15:00 UTC
sam: compact action list: - Nina: client circuit breaker + retry policy 1 due 2026-04-01; - Devon: pinned bundle fallback + verification due 2026-03-29; - Rahul: vendor SLA escalation + contact list due 2026-04-10.
rahul: observed recurring pattern: auth provider throttles when many long-lived token refreshes coincide with route reconvergence. mitigation idea: short-lived tokens + staggered refresh window per instance.
nina: testing notes: added 400-1000ms jitter and reduced retries 5->2, synthetic tests show tail latency improvement and fewer 429s.
devon: runbook snippet I added to ops repo:
```
- on model-fetch 5xx/429: mark region unhealthy for 20s, try alternate region, else use pinned bundle (signed) for 60s
- escalate to oncall if fallback used >3 times in 15m
```
sam: please add task statuses to INC-2026-0401-multi-dep-mitigation and keep updates here. I'll consolidate for the exec follow-up.
rahul: adding vendor emergency contacts: AuthCo-escalate@authco.example, CloudNet-oncall@cloudnet.example. asked for commitment on failover SLAs.
ina: small blocker: client library needs minor API change for circuit breaker. filing INT-331 for engineering. marking my task blocked until INT-331 has a PR.
sam: noted. we'll review blockers at 48h check-in. tagging thread as postmortem-followup.
